# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Overview

> 17 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Analytics](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/analytics.md): Get organization-wide activity summaries for a date range.
- [API Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/api_keys.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Cost Report](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/cost_report.md): Get Cost Report
- [External Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys.md): Identifier of the external key config. A tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or — for organizations on the Claude Platform on AWS — the AWS KMS key ARN.
- [Federation Issuers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_issuers.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Federation Rules](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/federation_rules.md): Include archived resources. Defaults to false.
- [Invites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/invites.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [MCP Tunnels](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/mcp_tunnels.md): Include archived tunnels in the results. Archived tunnels are excluded by default.
- [Organizations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/organizations.md): Retrieve information about the organization associated with the authenticated API key.
- [Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rate_limits.md): Rate-limit entries for the organization, one per group.
- [RBAC Groups](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_groups.md): Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.
- [RBAC Roles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/rbac_roles.md): Optionally set to the `next_page` token from the previous response.
- [Service Accounts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/service_accounts.md): Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409.
- [Spend Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits.md): Maximum number of members per page. A member's period rows never split across pages, so a page may carry more rows than this.
- [Usage Report](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/usage_report.md): Get Messages Usage Report
- [Users](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/users.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/workspaces.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
